ENABLE_VERIFICATION_API=true was already seeded by the baseline fixture itself (FD-GATE-1 fix present at this head).

Post-window-open data-only seed: organizations.tier for the fixture org set FREE->ENTERPRISE at ~16:07Z after the B-volume lane hit the per-org daily plan quota (perOrgRateLimit TIER_QUOTAS: FREE caps anchors_created at 100/day; the planned 13,200/day volume models a partner-scale org, which is exactly the ENTERPRISE row). The ~100-accept/~60-deny FREE-quota interval is honest in-window evidence of the #2251 denial path: 429 ORG_QUOTA_EXCEEDED with truthful quota headers, no quota consumed by denials.
